faq.q: How long until I get the piece?
faq.a: Every piece is made specifically for you and shipped from the workshop, so it takes longer than furniture from stock. The exact delivery time is given on order confirmation.

Tops are natural oak veneer — a thin layer of real oak — on an MDF or plywood core, more stable than solid wood. Edges and fronts are solid oak. That is how we describe it everywhere, without calling it “solid wood” when it is not.

faq.q: Can I order a different size?
faq.a: Most pieces come in several set sizes. Need another one? Tell us in the form — we will check with the workshop and come back with an answer and a price.

Yes. The price includes VAT, delivery and assembly at home. If access to your home is special (a high floor without a lift, for example), we will discuss it in advance. The area and access will be confirmed in the offer.
No payment is made on the site. First we confirm the order with you in writing — price, specification and delivery date — and only then you pay.

faq.q: Is the price on the site final?
faq.a: Production of the series has not started yet, so prices on the site are still estimates. The final price is confirmed with you in writing before any payment.
Warranty terms will be stated in the written offer, before any order.
Images on the site are 3D visualisations made from the specification and are labelled “Visualisation”. Photographs of the furniture itself will follow when they exist.

faq.q: How do I care for oak?
faq.a: Wipe with a damp, well-wrung cloth, without harsh cleaners. Use coasters for hot dishes. Full instructions come with the piece.

privacy_html:
Privacy policy

Updated: 21 October 2026

Who runs the site

The site is run by the ALUMA team during pre-launch. Details of the legal entity that will sell the furniture will be published here before sales begin. For any privacy matter you can write to us through the form on the site or by email at .

What we collect

When you fill in the registration form: name, phone, city (if given), the piece, size, finish and base you chose, when it is relevant, how to contact you, your note, and the consents you ticked.

Technical browsing data: pages viewed, where you came from (for example a campaign), device type, screen size and browser language. We do not store your IP address: it is passed through a one-way hash with a secret key and only the result is kept.

Giving information is voluntary

You are not legally required to give any information. Without a name and phone we cannot get back to you — that is the only consequence.

How we use it

  • to get back to you about your request and send an offer;
  • to understand which pieces and sizes interest people, and to improve the site;
  • to measure our advertising — only if you accepted cookies.

Cookies and third-party tools

The site stores a visit identifier and the source of your visit in your browser. If you agree in the notice at the bottom of the screen, Meta Pixel and Microsoft Clarity are also loaded, when they are enabled on the site. Without your consent they are not loaded.

How long we keep it

Requests are kept until you ask us to delete them. Browsing data is deleted after 180 days, visit identifiers after 400 days.

Who we share it with

We do not sell information. Your details reach the ALUMA team and the workshop to the extent needed for the offer and production. The server is hosted by a provider in Europe.

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete your information — write to us and we will handle it promptly.
terms_html:
Terms of use

Updated: 21 October 2026

Pre-launch

The site presents a furniture series before production starts. Nothing is sold and nothing is paid on the site; a request to confirm an order sent on the site is not a binding order; an order is made only on written confirmation by both sides.

Prices and timing

Prices and lead times on the site are estimates, not yet confirmed. A binding price, timing, specification and warranty terms appear only in a written offer sent to you, and only your written acceptance of that offer is an order.

Images

Images on the site are 3D visualisations from the specification. Wood tone and texture vary slightly from piece to piece in reality — that is the nature of wood.

Site content

Content and designs on the site belong to ALUMA. Do not copy them for commercial use without permission.
accessibility_html:
Accessibility statement

Last reviewed: 21 October 2026

We want everyone to be able to use this site. It is built to the Israeli standard IS 5568 (based on WCAG 2.0 level AA) and in practice to WCAG 2.1 level AA, under the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 2013.

What we did

  • Full keyboard navigation, a “skip to content” link and a clearly visible focus;
  • Contrast of at least 4.5:1 for all text, and text that can be enlarged to 200% without losing content;
  • Alternative text for every image, and a “visualisation” label on every render;
  • Forms with written labels and text error messages announced to screen readers;
  • Language and direction set for every page and every Hebrew fragment;
  • The device’s “reduce motion” setting is respected;
  • Our own accessibility menu (no third-party plug-in): larger text, high contrast, highlighted links, stop animations.

Known limitations

  • The 3D view is a visual extra; everything it shows is also in the specification table on the product page.
  • Images are visualisations; real photographs will be added later with alternative text.

Accessibility coordinator

Found a problem? Write to us through the form on the site or by e-mail at , and describe what you tried to do and on which page. We will reply within 14 days and fix it.
